skill.displayName: Specter CLI – AI powered startup and deal sourcing
skill.summary: Enrich, search, and manage company and professional data, lists, saved searches, and signals using the Specter intelligence platform via CLI.

latestVersion.changelog: Enrich, search, and manage company and people data from the Specter intelligence platform via the specter-cli.  Look up companies by domain, enrich professionals via LinkedIn, manage lists, query saved searches, and track talent and investor signals.
